input.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Section 9(b) contains a substantive Kubient warranty set (performance to industry standards, services free from errors materially affecting utility, security, no viruses, compliance with Law), and the Section 13 disclaimer expressly preserves the express warranties, so this is not a walk-away \"AS IS\" clause. It nonetheless fails the fallback on two material terms: there is no conformance warranty for the Auction Platform, software or deliverables against documentation for any stated period, and there is no warranty remedy at all (no repair, replacement or refund). The continuing Service warranty in 9(b)(ii) runs throughout the Term and so already satisfies the 30-day services duration. We therefore add the shortest fallback-level clause: a 90-day documentation conformance warranty plus a repair/replace/refund remedy, leaving the rest of Section 9 untouched.

ops.text: (xii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Auction Platform and any software or deliverables provided hereunder will conform in all material respects to their documentation. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this paragraph 9(b) is, at Customer's election, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Service, software or deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid or retained by Kubient for it.
